title: Many failures in inductor/test_max_autotune on H100
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Running this test suite on a System with H100 GPUs and CUDA 12.6 results in many failures and errors.

The following tests all ERROR with:
> torch._inductor.exc.InductorError: TypeError: only integer tensors of a single element can be converted to an index

```
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_False_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_True_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_False_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_True_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_False_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_True_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_False_dynamic_True
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_True_dynamic_True
```

The following tests fail with large differences like:

```
Mismatched elements: 41585 / 41664 (99.8%)
Greatest absolute difference: 155.375 at index (9, 206) (up to 0.01 allowed)
Greatest relative difference: 1913.0 at index (42, 58) (up to 0.01 allowed)
```

```
test_baddmm
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_False_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_True_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_False_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_addmm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_True_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_False_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_False_b_transposed_True_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_False_dynamic_False
test_max_autotune_regular_mm_persistent_tma_a_transposed_True_b_transposed_True_dynamic_False
test_non_contiguous_input_addmm
```

And `test_low_precision` fails (see also https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/154228) with
> RuntimeError: Expected to not find ".run(" but found it

This happens for 2.7.1 & 2.8
